permissions: Requests require a logged-in WordPress user. Omit user_id to use the current user's data, or pass user_id to target another account when the caller can edit that user (edit_user capability). Unauthenticated requests return fc_api_forbidden. An invalid user_id returns fc_api_user_not_found.

responseShape.successWithData: HTTP 200 with { "data": { ... } } when the handler returns a payload.
responseShape.successWithoutData: HTTP 200 with { "success": true } when there is no payload (for example DELETE).
responseShape.errors: Failures return WordPress REST error JSON from WP_Error (code, message, data.status). Wire codes use the fc_api_* prefix.

fc_api_required_field_missing.message: A required address field is missing.

fc_api_invalid_country.message: Country is invalid or has no address fields.

fc_api_invalid_request.message: The request could not be processed.
